description: This file defines a Visitor class for traversing and mutating a structural schema, including methods for visiting structural nodes and nested value validations.

classes.name: Visitor
classes.description: A class that recursively walks through a structural schema, allowing mutation and validation of schema nodes.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Starts the recursive traversal of a Structural schema node.

methods.name: visitStructural
methods.description: Recursively visits Structural nodes, applying callback functions and traversing child nodes.

methods.name: visitNestedValueValidation
methods.description: Recursively visits NestedValueValidation nodes, applying callback functions and traversing child nodes.
